summary: Multi-Task Activity Tracking specification was already fully compliant. Applied optional enhancement from trace recommendations to improve persistent metric storage.

changesApplied.changeMade: Added optional 'duration' (number, milliseconds) and 'cost' (number, USD) fields to sessionsSpawned schema
changesApplied.reason: Enhances Multi-Task Activity Tracking by persisting per-task duration and cost metrics in the activity record. Previously, these metrics were only tracked in the in-memory taskResults array. This change enables long-term analysis, reporting, and historical comparison of task performance.

consumers: Activity correctness validation (activity-correctness.ts) - reads sessionsSpawned count, no impact
Activity history dashboard - will benefit from richer per-task metrics
Template executor (template-executor.ts) - reads existing sessions, no impact
Activity tool (activity.ts) - updated to populate new fields

changesApplied.designDecision: Fields are optional to avoid breaking existing activity records and to handle edge cases where duration/cost might not be available (e.g., deterministic tasks with no LLM calls)
changesApplied.validationStatus: Build passed - all 11 target binaries compiled successfully

changesApplied.changeMade: Added duration and cost values when pushing to activity.executionEvidence.sessionsSpawned
changesApplied.reason: Implements the schema enhancement by populating the newly added duration and cost fields with actual task execution metrics. Uses the already-computed duration and cost variables available in the execution context.

impactAnalysis.dataFlow: duration and cost variables are already computed from task metrics at line 2868-2869, simply passed through to sessionsSpawned entry

changesApplied.codeContext: Changes made within the task execution loop after task completion. The duration and cost variables are available from task metrics computation. No additional calculations needed.

enhancementsApplied.enhancement: Persist per-task duration and cost in executionEvidence.sessionsSpawned
enhancementsApplied.rationale: Trace impulse identified that taskResults array tracks duration/cost in-memory but executionEvidence.sessionsSpawned (persistent storage) only had session metadata. Adding duration/cost to permanent storage enables historical analysis.
enhancementsApplied.benefit: Enables long-term analysis of task performance trends, cost optimization, and comprehensive activity reporting without relying on in-memory data structures
